verdict.rationale: Bolt.new supports server-side logic and integrations via Supabase (hosted DB, auth, edge functions) and has a documented Stripe integration for payments, plus general Node.js/npm and third-party API support from the builder. However, these are outsourced to third-party providers rather than native backend tooling, no email integration is documented, and community reports cite broken payment functionality and limits to backend depth when relying on Supabase.
